avoid: Do not use position or color as the sole speaker indication.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: Speaker attribution and message content are readable text. Alignment and tint are redundant cues.
updatesAndDescendants: Bubble is a div composition with start/end alignment. BubbleContent can useRender a native action/link. BubbleReactions positions caller-provided controls; the component has no built-in reaction state, persistence or callback.
referenceDecision: The example reaction is an ordinary labelled Button owned by the caller; no fabricated like API is attached to Bubble.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Bubble binds all four actual wrappers. The native Primary depiction maps to the selected React API variant=default, not an invented primary prop. Native 22px corners, 10/12px insets, 14/20px text and 32px representative group spacing become reusable roles; the short primary text uses a Light face while longer specimens use Regular, and this reference explicitly selects Regular consistently. Native widths/heights remain text-dependent. All seven actual variant classes are described, including source-supported ghost without a separate native master. The unbound #C7E8FF tinted surface keeps its observed #0A0A0A text as a fixed pair across modes rather than inventing an unseen dark tint. Outline uses an inset stroke without increasing native intrinsic height. Reactions retain 2/6px insets, 4px gap and rounded surface; top/bottom half-overlap and 12px inline inset are explicit positioning decisions. Native passive reactions are 24px; an interactive child Button may enlarge this intrinsic surface. Speaker text is mandatory in this usage. Reaction state and native content actions belong to callers, not Bubble callbacks.
